# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# =============================================================================
# Arch Linux AI development container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rendered by `build.py` from Dockerfile.j2 -- do not edit the generated file.
#
# Template context (all keys are required, StrictUndefined is enabled):
#   gpu_vendor             none | nvidia | amd
#   gpu_driver_package     Arch package providing the kernel module
#   gpu_name               marketing name, for labels
#   gpu_driver_version     host driver version, informational
#   gpu_needs_aur_fallback driver too old for official repos -> use pikaur
#   python_version         resolved and clamped by detect.py
#   torch_backend          cpu | cu128 | rocm6.4
#   llm_backend            llama.cpp | vllm
#   model_kind             gguf | huggingface
#   model_source           build-context path or HuggingFace repo id
#   model_repo_id          set only for remote HuggingFace repo ids
#   code_server_port       HTTP port for code-server
#   llm_port               OpenAI-compatible port for the model server
#   vnc_resolution         virtual screen geometry
#   enable_ssh             install and start sshd
# =============================================================================

FROM archlinux:latest

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="myarch" \
      org.opencontainers.image.description="Arch Linux AI remote development container" \
      org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/fufurobot/myarch" \
      myarch.gpu.vendor="none" \
      myarch.torch.backend="cpu" \
      myarch.llm.backend="llama.cpp"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build arguments
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BuildKit warns about secrets in ARG: the value lands in the image history.
# These are development defaults only. For anything real, pass the value at
# build time and rotate it, or mount it with `docker build --secret`.
ARG ADMIN_MASTER_PASSWORD=ChangeMeAdminMaster
ARG VNC_PASSWORD=ChangeMeVnc
ARG CODE_SERVER_PASSWORD=ChangeMeCodeServer
ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.8
ARG CODE_SERVER_VERSION=4.141.0
ARG LLAMA_CPP_REF=master

ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8 \
    LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/uv/python \
    VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/venv \
    PATH="/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}" \
    MYARCH_LLM_BACKEND=llama.cpp \
    MYARCH_GPU_VENDOR=none

# =============================================================================
# 1. Base system
# =============================================================================
RUN pacman-key --init \
 && pacman-key --populate archlinux \
 && pacman -Sy --noconfirm --needed archlinux-keyring \
 && pacman -Syu --noconfirm \
 && pacman -S --noconfirm --needed \
      base-devel \
      bash-completion \
      ca-certificates \
      cmake \
      curl \
      git \
      jq \
      less \
      nano \
      ninja \
      openssh \
      procps-ng \
      python \
      rsync \
      sudo \
      systemd \
      unzip \
      vim \
      wget \
      which \
      zip \
 && sed -i 's/^#\(en_US\.UTF-8\)/\1/' /etc/locale.gen \
 && locale-gen \
 && echo "LANG=en_US.UTF-8" > /etc/locale.conf \
 && rm -rf /var/cache/pacman/pkg/*
# Only the downloaded archives are cleaned. /var/lib/pacman/sync is deliberately
# kept: deleting it leaves pacman with no targets, and every later `pacman -S`
# then fails with "target not found" no matter how correct the package names
# are. Sync explicitly in each layer that installs packages.

# =============================================================================
# 1b. Users and groups with least-privilege sudo
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each grant is written to its own file in /etc/sudoers.d and validated with
# `visudo -cf`, so a malformed rule fails the build instead of locking sudo.
# =============================================================================

# administrator-master -- unrestricted sudo
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash --groups wheel administrator-master \
 && printf 'administrator-master:%s\n' "${ADMIN_MASTER_PASSWORD}" | chpasswd \
 && printf 'administrator-master ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/10-administrator-master \
 && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/10-administrator-master \
 && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/10-administrator-master \
 && chage -d 0 administrator-master

# pikaur-manager -- ONLY the exact pikaur invocation.
# [!-]* permits any argument that does not begin with a dash, which blocks
# option injection such as `--pikaur-config=/etc/shadow`.
RUN groupadd --gid 1005 pikaur-manager 2>/dev/null || true \
 && useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash --uid 1005 --gid 1005 --home-dir /home/pikaur-manager pikaur-manager \
 && echo 'pikaur-manager:iknowtheremotecodeisdangerous' | chpasswd \
 && printf '%s\n' \
      'pikaur-manager ALL=(root) /usr/bin/pikaur -Syu [!-]* --pikaur-config=/home/pikaur-manager/.config/pikaur.conf --user-id=1005 --group-id=1005 --home-dir=/home/pikaur-manager --xdg-cache-home=/home/pikaur-manager/.cache --xdg-data-home=/home/pikaur-manager/.local/share' \
      > /etc/sudoers.d/20-pikaur-manager \
 && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/20-pikaur-manager \
 && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/20-pikaur-manager \
 && mkdir -p /home/pikaur-manager/.config /home/pikaur-manager/.cache /home/pikaur-manager/.local/share \
 && chown -R pikaur-manager:pikaur-manager /home/pikaur-manager
# NOTE: pikaur-manager's password is expired *after* the pikaur build below.
# Expiring it here would make `su - pikaur-manager` prompt for a password
# change, which cannot succeed in a non-interactive build.

# developer -- ONLY pacman
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash developer \
 && echo 'developer:iwillnotinstallpackagesidonotownsourcecode' | chpasswd \
 && printf 'developer ALL=(root) /usr/bin/pacman\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/30-developer \
 && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/30-developer \
 && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/30-developer \
 && chage -d 0 developer

# system-manager -- ONLY fdisk, mount and ls
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash system-manager \
 && echo 'system-manager:iwillnotstealotherusersdata' | chpasswd \
 && printf 'system-manager ALL=(root) /usr/bin/fdisk, /usr/bin/mount, /usr/bin/ls\n' \
      > /etc/sudoers.d/40-system-manager \
 && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/40-system-manager \
 && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/40-system-manager \
 && chage -d 0 system-manager

# service-manager -- ONLY systemctl
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash service-manager \
 && echo 'service-manager:iwillnotstartuntrustedservices' | chpasswd \
 && printf 'service-manager ALL=(root) /usr/bin/systemctl\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/50-service-manager \
 && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/50-service-manager \
 && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/50-service-manager \
 && chage -d 0 service-manager

# user -- an ordinary account with no sudo rights at all.
RUN useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash user \
 && echo 'user:iamsafe' | chpasswd \
 && chage -d 0 user \
 && rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/user

# The container runs with the primary desktop/development account as `user`.
USER root

# =============================================================================
# 1c. sshd with password authentication
# =============================================================================
RUN ssh-keygen -A \
 && sed -i \
      -e 's/^#\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' \
      -e 's/^#\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/' \
      -e 's/^#\?ChallengeResponseAuthentication.*/ChallengeResponseAuthentication no/' \
      /etc/ssh/sshd_config \
 && printf '\n# myarch overrides\nPasswordAuthentication yes\nPermitRootLogin no\n' \
      > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-myarch.conf \
 && mkdir -p /run/sshd \
 && /usr/sbin/sshd -t

# =============================================================================
# 2. pikaur (AUR helper) built from source with makepkg
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# makepkg refuses to run as root, so the build runs as pikaur-manager via su.
# The root-installing makepkg flag is deliberately NOT used: installing needs
# root, which the restricted sudoers rule forbids. We build the package archive
# as pikaur-manager, then install that archive as root with pacman.
# =============================================================================
# runuser drops privileges without PAM's interactive password handling, which
# su performs even for a non-expired account and which cannot work here.
#
# `makepkg -s` would install the makedepends itself, but that needs root, which
# the restricted pikaur-manager sudoers rule deliberately does not grant. So the
# dependencies are installed here as root and makepkg runs with --nodeps. The
# list mirrors makedepends in the AUR PKGBUILD; python-markdown-it-py in
# particular is required by pikaur's man-page generator.
RUN pacman -Syu --noconfirm \
 && pacman -S --noconfirm --needed \
      python-wheel \
      python-hatchling \
      python-build \
      python-installer \
      python-setuptools \
      python-markdown-it-py
RUN chown -R pikaur-manager:pikaur-manager /home/pikaur-manager \
 && runuser -u pikaur-manager -- git clone --depth 1 https://aur.archlinux.org/pikaur.git /home/pikaur-manager/pikaur \
 && chown -R pikaur-manager:pikaur-manager /home/pikaur-manager/pikaur \
 && runuser -u pikaur-manager -- bash -lc 'cd /home/pikaur-manager/pikaur && makepkg -fs --noconfirm --nodeps'
RUN pacman -Syu --noconfirm \
 && pacman -U --noconfirm /home/pikaur-manager/pikaur/*.pkg.tar.* \
 && pacman -S --noconfirm --needed pyalpm \
 && mkdir -p /home/pikaur-manager/.config \
 && printf '[sync]\nalwaysshowupgrades = no\n\n[build]\nkeepbuilddir = no\nskipreview = no\n' \
      > /home/pikaur-manager/.config/pikaur.conf \
 && chown -R pikaur-manager:pikaur-manager /home/pikaur-manager \
 && chage -d 0 pikaur-manager
# Verify the install without running pikaur: `pikaur --version` initialises its
# directories via systemd at import time and a build container has no init
# system, so it fails with "System has not been booted with systemd". Checking
# the installed files and importing the module proves the same thing.
# pikaur keeps its version in config.py rather than on the package, so ask
# pacman for the version and only use the import as a smoke test.
RUN test -x /usr/bin/pikaur \
 && /usr/bin/python -c "import pikaur.config" \
 && pacman -Q pikaur

# =============================================================================
# 3. GPU drivers -- none requested, CPU-only image
# =============================================================================
RUN echo "No usable GPU detected on the host; building a CPU-only image."

# =============================================================================
# 4. KDE Plasma desktop + VNC server, one 1920x1080 virtual screen
# =============================================================================
RUN pacman -Syu --noconfirm \
 && pacman -S --noconfirm --needed \
      plasma-desktop \
      plasma-workspace \
      konsole \
      dolphin \
      systemsettings \
      xorg-server \
      xorg-xinit \
      xorg-xauth \
      xorg-xrdb \
      xorg-setxkbmap \
      dbus \
      ttf-dejavu \
      tigervnc \
 && rm -rf /var/cache/pacman/pkg/*

# Exactly one virtual screen at 1920x1080, running KDE Plasma.
# The server is started once, at runtime, by entrypoint.sh with:
#     vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24
RUN mkdir -p /home/user/.vnc /home/user/.config \
 && printf '#!/bin/sh\nunset SESSION_MANAGER\nunset DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS\nexec dbus-launch --exit-with-session startplasma-x11\n' \
      > /home/user/.vnc/xstartup \
 && chmod +x /home/user/.vnc/xstartup \
 && printf 'geometry=1920x1080\ndepth=24\n' > /home/user/.vnc/config \
 && printf '%s\n' "${VNC_PASSWORD}" | vncpasswd -f > /home/user/.vnc/passwd \
 && chmod 0600 /home/user/.vnc/passwd \
 && chown -R user:user /home/user/.vnc /home/user/.config \
 && echo "virtual screen pinned to 1920x1080" > /home/user/.vnc/GEOMETRY

# =============================================================================
# 5. uv + Python matching the analysed script
# =============================================================================
RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local/bin sh \
 && uv --version \
 && uv python install 3.8 \
 && uv python pin 3.8 \
 && uv venv /opt/venv --python 3.8 \
 && /opt/venv/bin/python --version

# =============================================================================
# 6. PyTorch for the detected backend
# =============================================================================
RUN uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
RUN uv pip install --python /opt/venv/bin/python torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

# =============================================================================
# 7. Inference backend: vLLM on GPU, llama.cpp on CPU
# =============================================================================
# llama.cpp is built from source so it can target the host CPU/GPU correctly.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp /opt/llama.cpp \
 && cd /opt/llama.cpp \
 && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -DGGML_NATIVE=ON \
 && cmake --build build --config Release -j"$(nproc)" \
 && install -m 0755 build/bin/llama-server /usr/local/bin/llama-server \
 && install -m 0755 build/bin/llama-cli /usr/local/bin/llama-cli \
 && rm -rf /opt/llama.cpp/build/CMakeFiles

# =============================================================================
# 8. code-server, installed per the code-server-aur method
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# https://github.com/coder/code-server-aur -- the AUR PKGBUILD unpacks the
# upstream GitHub release tarball into /usr/lib/code-server and symlinks the
# launcher. We therefore fetch the GitHub release tarball directly instead of
# piping the vendor installer script, which no longer serves generic clients.
# =============================================================================
ARG CODE_SERVER_VERSION
RUN set -eux; \
    arch="$(uname -m)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      x86_64)  cs_arch=amd64 ;; \
      aarch64) cs_arch=arm64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    url="https://github.com/coder/code-server/releases/download/v${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}/code-server-${CODE_SERVER_VERSION}-linux-${cs_arch}.tar.gz"; \
    curl -fsSL "$url" -o /tmp/code-server.tar.gz; \
    mkdir -p /usr/lib/code-server; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/code-server.tar.gz -C /usr/lib/code-server --strip-components=1; \
    rm -f /tmp/code-server.tar.gz; \
    ln -sf /usr/lib/code-server/bin/code-server /usr/bin/code-server; \
    code-server --version

# Configure code-server for the `user` account.
RUN mkdir -p /home/user/.config/code-server /home/user/.local/share/code-server \
 && printf 'bind-addr: 0.0.0.0:8443\nauth: password\npassword: ${CODE_SERVER_PASSWORD}\ncert: false\n' \
      > /home/user/.config/code-server/config.yaml \
 && chown -R user:user /home/user/.config/code-server /home/user/.local/share/code-server

# Continue extension, pointed at the closed-loop local model server.
RUN sudo -u user code-server --install-extension Continue.continue || \
    echo "Continue extension install deferred to runtime" \
 && mkdir -p /home/user/.continue \
 && printf '%s\n' \
      'name: myarch-local' \
      'version: 1.0.0' \
      'schema: v1' \
      'models:' \
      '  - name: myarch-local' \
      '    provider: openai' \
      '    model: local-model' \
      '    apiBase: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1' \
      '    apiKey: myarch-local' \
      '    roles:' \
      '      - chat' \
      '      - edit' \
      '      - apply' \
      'context:' \
      '  - provider: code' \
      '  - provider: diff' \
      '  - provider: terminal' \
      '  - provider: problems' \
      > /home/user/.continue/config.yaml \
 && chown -R user:user /home/user/.continue

# =============================================================================
# 9. aichat, configured against the same local model server
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Research note: aichat ships in the official `extra` repository (0.30.0-4);
# it is NOT an AUR package, so pacman is the correct installer.
RUN pacman -Syu --noconfirm \
 && pacman -S --noconfirm --needed aichat \
 && rm -rf /var/cache/pacman/pkg/* \
 && mkdir -p /home/user/.config/aichat \
 && printf '%s\n' \
      'model: local:local-model' \
      'clients:' \
      '  - type: openai-compatible' \
      '    name: local' \
      '    api_base: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1' \
      '    api_key: myarch-local' \
      '    models:' \
      '      - name: local-model' \
      '        max_input_tokens: 32768' \
      > /home/user/.config/aichat/config.yaml \
 && chown -R user:user /home/user/.config/aichat

# =============================================================================
# Model packaging
# =============================================================================
# llama.cpp consumes a single gguf file.
COPY /home/runner/work/myarch/myarch/examples/demo.gguf /models/model.gguf
RUN chmod 0644 /models/model.gguf
ENV MYARCH_MODEL_PATH=/models/model.gguf

# =============================================================================
# Runtime
# =============================================================================
COPY entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh \
 && bash -n /usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh

EXPOSE 22 5900 8443 8080

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=5 \
    CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/models || exit 1

WORKDIR /home/user
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]
